title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: An in-depth media report examining Fabio Giglietto's investigation of Meta's algorithmic suppression of democratic political speech on Facebook. The article details how his research, which analyzed over 2.5 million posts, exposed that extremist pages became the most prominent political information ecosystem on Facebook during the 2024 European elections.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.

title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: This news article reports on Fabio Giglietto's study evaluating Meta's content reduction policies [2.4.5]. The study reveals a significant asymmetry where Facebook's algorithms dramatically reduced the visibility of official democratic political figures (by up to 73.4% compared to 2021) while letting extremist and anti-European accounts maintain or increase their reach.
description: A news article reporting on a study by Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino, which analyzes how Facebook's algorithms impact the visibility of official political accounts versus extremist content.
